Final Rotations for the Nuggets who defeat the Pacers 114-102.

Bench lineup in 2Q was the big key here. Gave Denver the margin they needed.

Solid lines from Jokic, Murray, and Cam Johnson as well.

Denver starts the road trip with a W.

The Pacers rallied in the third quarter, but just couldn't seal the deal in the fourth and fell 114-102 to the Denver Nuggets in Mexico City.

Pascal Siakam led Indiana in scoring with 23 points while Ivica Zubac had a double-double of 10 points and 12 rebounds.
